faq.a1: Nothing. SofIA is free and funded by ads, always clearly labelled. You decide whether they're tailored to your interests in {path:settingsTitle,settingsOptionPrivacy,settingsPrivacyAds}. What you write, your interests and your wellbeing data never travel in an ad.
faq.a2: Whoever you choose, entry by entry: just you, your circle, your followers or everyone. You can post unsigned, schedule an entry for later and make your whole journal private.
faq.a3: It transcribes your audio, summarises and organises your entries and helps you spot the patterns. It runs on SofIA's servers and, in part, on your own mobile. Your journal is never used to train models. The AI Policy covers it in detail.
faq.a4: For now the app is in Spanish, and you can write in whichever language you like. We're getting more languages ready.
faq.a5: Yes, both, whenever you like. We talk you through it in Help and Delete your account.

pb.age: SofIA is for people aged 14 and over.
pb.auto: We order what you see by your affinities, and an automated system reviews what gets shared; private messages, only if someone reports them. You can object to the first and ask for a person to review the second.
pb.desc: A summary of how SofIA handles your data: who, what, why, where, for how long and your rights.
pb.health: Your health and wellbeing data, only with your explicit consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
pb.keep: For as long as you have an account. A deleted entry stays 30 days in the archive, and messages expire after 30 days. When you delete your account we erase everything except the minimum the law requires, which stays locked for 3 years.
pb.lede: A summary in your language of how we handle your data. The full text, which is the one that applies, is in Spanish: Política de privacidad.
pb.never: Sell your data, train AI models on your journal, or use your journal, your interests or your health to choose ads.
pb.rights: You can access your data and take it with you, correct it, delete it, object, restrict its use and withdraw your consent, in the app or by emailing legal@sofia.ismx.app. We reply within one month at most. If you disagree, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es) or to the authority where you live.
pb.title: Your privacy, at a glance
pb.what: Your account and profile; your journal and what our AI derives from it (transcription, summary and topics) so it works; your connections, comments and messages; an approximate location to show your entries to people nearby; what you read, to order what you see; reports and moderation decisions; and technical data for security and app crashes.
pb.where: On our servers in Germany, rented from IONOS, where our AI also runs. Google, Apple, Meta and GitHub receive some data, such as the text of notifications, for notifications, crash reports, ads, sign-in and the website, with the safeguards the GDPR requires for transfers outside the European Union.
pb.who: SofIA is a brand of PROGRAMSAN, S.L. (tax ID B40623829, Valencia, Spain), the data controller. For anything about your data, email legal@sofia.ismx.app, or our data protection officer at dpo@sofia.ismx.app.
pb.why: To provide the service you signed up for; to keep it safe, moderate it and recommend entries, based on our legitimate interest, which you can object to; to comply with the law; and, with your consent, for personalised ads and health data.
